concept_annotations.notes: Player independently praises scenery, decoration, music, and atmosphere as a coherent positive experience.
Relaxing is not assumed exact-equivalent to cozy; retained as overlapping comfort evidence.
Player explicitly reports that hint fireworks make collecting all 22 key items easy enough to complete.
Direct player enjoyment report; not inferred from rating/downloads.

concept_annotations.native_lexicalization: scenery is beautiful / decoration is exquisite
concept_annotations.notes: Aesthetic praise is only partial evidence for polish and is kept separate from technical correctness.

annotations.original_text_ref: Planet Minecraft v2 update log; no bulk copy retained

concept_annotations.notes: Creator records a concrete collectible/inventory defect fix; creator evidence is separated from player judgment.
The changelog establishes a collectible interaction path, but does not by itself prove its legibility to players.

initial_alignment_questions: Can the benchmark identify authored adventure starts where survival-resource scarcity is intentional rather than defective?
Can visual/audio/tour features explain atmosphere/coherence reports without claiming to measure player relaxation directly?
Can hint/collectible discoverability be measured through persona completion and time-to-discovery rather than resource counts?
Can technical collectible-loss defects be detected independently from visual polish?
preliminary_blind_metric_interpretation: The static survival bundle is absent near spawn, but this should be treated as profile mismatch rather than a negative quality result for an adventure/collectathon map.
A chest within five horizontal blocks of spawn supports an authored interaction start more than a vanilla survival start.
The single observed biome palette in the bounded spawn window does not imply low experiential variety across the full authored map.
limitations: The main independent qualitative comment is English text written by a Taiwanese Chinese-speaking player; it is cross-cultural evidence but not a native-Chinese lexicalization sample.
Creator changelog evidence is not independent player feedback.
The 4.6/5 rating is retained only as structured context and is not translated into any concept annotation.
